relationships.subject: NIR semiconductor laser irradiation

relationships.subject: NIR semiconductor laser irradiation
relationships.evidence_quote: High-frequency NIR semiconductor laser irradiation can reduce periodontal inflammation during orthodontic tooth movement.

key_findings: High-frequency NIR laser reduced IL-1β, PGE2 and CGRP expression in compressed periodontal ligament during experimental tooth movement in rats.
